# KONOV Technologies

> KONOV Technologies is Ghana's AI literacy hub helping young people understand, create, and build with artificial intelligence — through hands-on programs, school workshops, hackathons, and the Me AI creation platform.

KONOV Technologies is an edtech company, not a general coding/robotics school. Learners (ages 6-18) work with real data, train machine learning models, build chatbots and conversational AI, and create AI-powered projects. KONOV serves young learners, parents, schools, educators, tertiary students, NGOs, and organizations across Ghana and Africa.

## Core Pages

- [Home](/): KONOV Technologies' mission, programs, and impact.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, story, and values.
- [Programs](/programs): Full program lineup — Weekend AI Creators, School AI Program, AI Workshops, Summer AI & Tech Camp, Youth AI Challenges, and the Tertiary AI Innovation Program.
- [Me AI](/me-ai): KONOV's AI creation platform for learners ages 6-18 — build chatbots, train models, complete guided AI projects.
- [For Schools](/for-schools): School partnerships — student workshops, teacher training, Me AI classroom access, AI clubs, hackathons.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach KONOV Technologies by email or WhatsApp.
- [Blog](/blog): AI education insights for schools, teachers, and parents.
- [Hackathons / FORGE Studio](/hackathons): The live hackathon platform where learners build real Python-powered AI projects and compete.
- [Me AI App](https://meaitech.com): The Me AI platform itself.

## Program-Specific Pages

- [AI Classes for Kids in Accra](/ai-classes-for-kids-accra): AI classes for children and teens ages 6-16.
- [Machine Learning for Kids](/machine-learning-for-kids): How machine learning works, taught through hands-on projects.
- [Teacher Training](/teacher-training): AI training for teachers and educators in Ghana.
- [Tertiary AI Innovation Hub](/tertiary-ai-innovation-hub): Applied AI for tertiary/university students, featuring the free 7-day AI Builder Sprint (ends in a capstone hackathon with cash prizes).
- [Youth AI Hackathons](/youth-hackathons): AI hackathons and innovation challenges for young people.
- [Summer AI & Tech Camp](/summer-ai-tech-camp): Vacation AI and tech camp for primary through senior high learners.
- [AI Curriculum Support for Schools](/ai-curriculum-support): Grade-level-aligned AI curriculum design and teacher training for schools.

## Key Facts

- Official brand name: KONOV Technologies (also referenced as KONOV).
- Product name: Me AI — KONOV's AI creation platform for learners ages 6-18.
- Location: Accra, Ghana. Serves learners across Ghana and Africa.
- Contact: hello@konovtech.com
